scope.summary: Ensure every procedural construct (blend, live paint, gradient mesh, image trace, intertwine, repeat) persists its live parameters + source references as vector authority so it survives save/load and round-trips without being silently flattened, and exposes those parameters to the model command surface; a construct authorable only interactively and not inspectable/re-parameterizable by a model is non-conformant.
acceptance_criteria: all procedural constructs persist params + survive round-trip + model-re-parameterizable
expected_tests: live: each construct survives save/load round-trip without flattening; parameters model-readable + re-settable via command surface

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Constructs silently flatten on save/load; not model-re-parameterizable (non-conformant).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
